interface.model: conditional binomial output-count likelihood; matched input count is log-odds offset; WT-JUN x same partner is comparator
interface.zero_outputs: retained as observed binomial outcomes, not pseudocounts
interface.input_zero: replicate omitted because its input offset is undefined
interface.interval: 95% one-parameter profile likelihood conditional on observed inputs; no between-replicate random effect
interface.scope: diagnostic reanalysis of released processed counts, not an experimental result or calibrated thermodynamic-energy model

simultaneous_95_bonferroni.family: all 52 bZIP partners for a given single mutant
simultaneous_95_bonferroni.scope: conditional-input likelihood only; no replicate random effect
